name: Following Instructions
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of heeding godly instruction as a path to wisdom and safety, highlighting the value of parental guidance and counsel from others. The Psalms assure believers that God Himself will instruct and guide them, providing divine oversight in their journey. Proverbs underscores the blessing of receiving and following wise counsel, contrasting the wise who listen to instruction with those who reject correction. Jesus' command to the paralytic to rise and walk demonstrates the authority behind following divine commands and the transformative power that accompanies obedience.
